<!-- markdownlint-disable -->


**Update**: this PR now covers the act+MXFP4 quant fusion only (See below comment)
**Update (review round 2):** rebased on current main; changes and new measurements are in [this comment](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61902#issuecomment-6562210527). The run A4 table and the GSM8K block under Measurements are the newest figures in this body. The Qwen3.8-27B act-site count (64) an earlier version of this body reported predates #61278, it is 0 on current main, and it is not repeated here.


## Overview

Put the AITER act_and_mul + MXFP4 activation-quant fusion of #59153 behind an opt-in env flag (`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ACT_QUANT_FUSION`, gfx950 only), fix the small-batch path, split the compile ranges where the fusion stops paying, and add CI and tests. Builds on #59153 (its commit is the first commit of this PR, unchanged). Today that pass is registered whenever `fuse_act_quant` is on (by default vLLM enables that switch only in some configurations), so every start of an MXFP4 model on ROCm with that switch on would rewrite its down_proj sites. With this PR a default start is unchanged. With the flag on, the pass logs one line per pass call saying how many patterns it replaced, and the flag cannot fail a start: a model with no site logs 0 and runs.

The two Gemma add+RMSNorm fusions this PR first carried (the post-attention norm and the input norm) were dropped from this PR. On main the asm MXFP4 GEMM is chosen only for shapes that also have a tuned Triton preshuffle config (`process_weights_after_loading`, since #61278), and the fused norm op cannot serve those shapes yet (the small-M Triton branch reads unshuffled scales, the op writes the asm layout), so those fusions could not fire on main.

Not a duplicate: this PR adds no new fusion, the speed comes from #59153's kernel. #59153 is the fusion (SiLU/GELU+Mul before the down projection, on the asm path); this PR gates it, fixes the small-batch path it left, splits the compile ranges, and adds CI and tests. #59610 folds RMSNorm and SiLU+Mul into the MXFP4 quant on the Triton `afp4wfp4` path, which this pass does not touch. The files overlap with #59610 (`mxfp4/aiter.py`, `rocm_aiter_fusion.py`); both PRs conflict with #59153 in `mxfp4/aiter.py` in the same place, and I will rebase on whichever lands first.

## Claims

- On gfx950 with `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ACT_QUANT_FUSION=1` (and `fuse_act_quant` on, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`), each SiLU/GELU+Mul that feeds an asm MXFP4 GEMM (a down_proj) in a compile range above 64 tokens becomes one AITER kernel, as in #59153.
- Observable with the flag on: the pass logs one INFO line per pass call, `AITER act-mul + MXFP4 GEMM fusion: replaced N pattern(s)`, and the same count goes to the debug summary `fusion pass matches`. It is warn-and-skip, not a failure: when the model has no site, when AITER picks the Triton preshuffle GEMM for every shape, or when Inductor served every piece from its cache so the pass never ran, nothing is replaced and the start continues. An earlier version of this PR failed the start in some of those cases; that check is gone.
- Nothing changes with the flag unset (default off; the pass also needs `fuse_act_quant` on, AITER enabled and a gfx950). With the flag off there is no extra compile-range split either.
- With the flag on, compile ranges split at 64 tokens and the pass applies only to ranges that start above 64 (`MXFP4_PRESHUFFLE_MAX_M`), so a batch of 64 tokens or fewer compiles the unfused graph and the start compiles one more range. There the activation runs on the fused `_C` act-and-mul ops. Run A4's 32 user decode shows no measurable change.
- Speed and accuracy with only this flag on: measured on Llama 3.3 70B MXFP4 in run A4 and the GSM8K block under Measurements. Prefill TTFT median -1.8%, decode at 96 and 128 users around 1% better (mixed evidence, see the note under the table), decode at 32 users unchanged, GSM8K 5-shot exact match (flexible extract) 93.00% off and 94.33% on. An earlier version of this body claimed an act-site count of 64 on Qwen3.8-27B from a start-up log on an older head; that log no longer exists, the count was never taken on this head, and it is dropped here.

## Validation

Tests (the gating file, 38 cases, is new in this PR; `test_rocm_aiter_act_mul_mxfp4_fusion.py`, 45 cases, is #59153's own test file carried as this PR's first commit, plus 4 cases this PR adds: 3 for the tanh gate and 1 for the INFO log line of the pass):

```bash
pytest tests/compile/passes/test_rocm_aiter_mxfp4_fusion_gating.py \
       tests/compile/passes/test_rocm_aiter_act_mul_mxfp4_fusion.py -v
```

Both files run in the `:amd: (MI355) Fusion and Compile FP8` ROCm job in `.buildkite/test-amd.yaml`, which is marked optional there. Both files are also listed in `.buildkite/test_areas/compile.yaml`.

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| CPU emulation (fake ROCm and AITER), both files | 41 passed, 42 skipped (GPU-only cases skip on CPU) |
| MI350P, both files, image A | Gating: 37 passed, 1 skipped. Act: 27 passed, 18 failed (see note) |
| MI350P, act file, image B | 45 passed, including the 4 new tests |
| `ruff check`, `ruff format --check` (0.14.0) | clean |
| pre-commit hooks on the changed files | all passed |

Image A: `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm@sha256:e0be00f1b99da608cc3c8571c7c86bae0c05f19e1e61a59c1d70aeea6bca6140`

Image B: `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm@sha256:d92e7eb1171463b6a653eb0573e64ffdab15b668a26b3bef24b469914c707174`

Note: the 18 failures on image A are the asm-path cases. Each fails at import with `No module named 'aiter.ops.triton.fusions.activation'` because that AITER module is missing from the image. The code before this PR fails the same 18 there. Image B has the module and passes all 45.

The measured checkpoint is `amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4` with its `config.json` edited: eight module names of the MTP head were added to the end of the `quantization_config.exclude` list, so those modules are excluded from quantization. The names are `mtp.fc`, `mtp.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj`, `mtp.layers.0.self_attn.k_proj`, `mtp.layers.0.self_attn.v_proj`, `mtp.layers.0.self_attn.o_proj`, `mtp.layers.0.mlp.gate_proj`, `mtp.layers.0.mlp.up_proj` and `mtp.layers.0.mlp.down_proj`. The stock `config.json` was not measured. `<checkpoint dir>` below is a local directory with that edited copy.

Reproduce the fusion (one gfx950 card). With the flag on, the pass logs `AITER act-mul + MXFP4 GEMM fusion: replaced N pattern(s)` at INFO level, once per pass call. This exact command was not run on this head. The variable `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ASM_GEMM`, which an earlier version of this command set, is removed on main by #61278, so it is not set here. The `fuse_act_quant` pass switch must also be on (by default vLLM enables it only in some configurations), so the command sets it explicitly:

```bash
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ACT_QUANT_FUSION=1
vllm serve <checkpoint dir> --served-model-name amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 --max-model-len 60000 --max-num-seqs 128 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 --kv-cache-dtype auto --enable-prefix-caching \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA --gdn-prefill-backend aiter_flydsl \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3 --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":3,"video":0}' \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":2}' \
  -cc.pass_config.fuse_act_quant=True
```

**Measurements.** The end-to-end figures for this flag alone are the run A4 table and the GSM8K block below, both on Llama 3.3 70B MXFP4. The only figure an earlier version of this section carried was a Qwen3.8-27B act-site count taken from a start-up log that this PR removes; it is dropped.

Run A4 (Llama 3.3 70B MXFP4, two MI350P cards running at the same time, three OFF/ON pairs per card, six starts per arm with the flag off and the flag on, the server flags of run A3). `CU_NUM=256` was set, so AITER's 256-CU tuned tables apply on these 128-CU cards. The paired mean is the mean of the six ON-minus-OFF differences; the interval (95%) is a bootstrap over those six differences; the p value is an exact two-sided permutation test over the six OFF and six ON starts.

| metric | OFF median | ON median | median change | paired mean (95% CI) | p |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| prefill, 4096-token prompt: TTFT (ms) | 516.57 | 507.43 | -1.8% | -1.7% (-1.9 to -1.5) | 0.002 |
| decode, 32 users: TPOT (ms) | 32.32 | 32.39 | +0.2% | +0.1% (-0.1 to +0.4) | 0.82 |
| decode, 96 users: TPOT (ms) | 60.02 | 59.40 | -1.0% | -0.8% (-1.3 to -0.2) | 0.13 |
| decode, 96 users: output tok/s | 1463.10 | 1480.17 | +1.2% | +0.8% (+0.4 to +1.3) | 0.09 |
| decode, 128 users: TPOT (ms) | 75.38 | 74.60 | -1.0% | -0.7% (-1.1 to -0.2) | 0.49 |
| decode, 128 users: output tok/s | 1581.47 | 1602.44 | +1.3% | +0.8% (+0.5 to +1.2) | 0.18 |

The table shows a small prefill gain and small decode gains at 96 and 128 users, and no measurable change in 32 user decode. For the 96 and 128 user decode rows the paired 95% interval excludes 0, but the unpaired test gives p above 0.05, so treat those gains as likely but small.

GSM8K (Llama 3.3 70B MXFP4, run A3, flags as run A4):

- lm_eval `gsm8k`, 5-shot, 300 questions (lm_eval limit 300).
- Exact match, flexible-extract: flag off 93.00%, flag on 94.33%.
- Exact match, strict-match: flag off 1.00%, flag on 2.33%. Strict match needs the exact answer format, so it is low for both arms.
- The two arms differ by 4 of the 300 questions.

## Details

**The gate.** `act_mxfp4_pass_registered` (`vllm/_aiter_ops.py`) is the single rule for the pass: `rocm_aiter_ops.is_enabled()`, the pass config's `fuse_act_quant`, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ACT_QUANT_FUSION=1` and a gfx950. `PostGradPassManager` registers `RocmAiterActMulMxfp4GemmFusionPass` only when that holds. The other AITER passes have a rule for RDNA AITER (gfx12); this one does not register there, because the asm MXFP4 GEMM it folds into needs gfx950. The flag is part of the compile cache key like every vLLM env var (a test checks that the flag changes the compile cache key).

**The compile-range split.** `VllmConfig` adds a compile-range endpoint at `MXFP4_PRESHUFFLE_MAX_M` (64, `vllm/_aiter_ops.py`) exactly when that same rule holds, and the pass's `is_applicable_for_range` applies it only to ranges that start above 64. At 64 tokens or fewer AITER can pick its tuned Triton preshuffle GEMM, where `gemm_with_dynamic_quant` splits the activation out again, so the fusion would save nothing there. With the flag on the split applies to any model, so a start compiles one more range.

**Small batches.** In the branch the fusion does not cover, `gemm_with_dynamic_quant` calls `_act_and_mul`, which runs one `torch.ops._C.silu_and_mul`, `gelu_and_mul` or `gelu_tanh_and_mul` per call instead of an eager activation and multiply, so the small-batch path no longer runs a separate eager activation kernel.

**The ROCm tanh GELU warning.** The pass now builds the tanh GELU pattern only when the `gelu_and_mul` custom op is on. With it off (the default under torch.compile), that pattern traces to the same graph as exact GELU on ROCm and was dropped anyway, so the pass no longer creates the layer and the warning is not logged. With it on, the warning still logs once per process.

**Limits.** gfx950 asm MXFP4 path only. The fusion applies to the down_proj layers where AITER selects the asm GEMM, which on main means shapes with both an asm tuned config and a tuned Triton preshuffle config; layers with other shapes are left unfused and the pass simply reports 0 replacements there. Size: 13 files changed (10 under `vllm/` and `tests/`, plus two CI files and one doc), 1139 lines added and 6 removed, about 870 of them tests. Expected to work on any gfx950 (MI350X, MI355X, MI350P); tested only on MI350P (128 CU). On 256-CU parts, AITER's shipped tuned tables route some GEMM shapes to the Triton preshuffle path, which is not an asm GEMM and so not a site, so fewer sites may fuse there.

  4. A line in the ROCm docs listing the flag.

Hi @fyun89, thanks for the rescope. A few things:

- the gfx950 cases still don't run in CI. Both files are collected by the MI300 compile/passes job, but every gfx950-gated case skips there, and the MI355 job (".buildkite/test-amd.yaml", ":amd: (MI355) Fusion and Compile FP8") lists its files explicitly. Can you add both files to that command?
- can you share decode and prefill numbers for this head, flag off vs on, same machine and workload? Decode is the one I want to see, I think for now at M <= 64 the op still runs the act separately, so any win would be prefill-only?
- `test_every_set_model_tag_in_the_source_tree_is_classified` keeps its own copy of the tag list (`MODEL_INTERNAL_TAGS`) and compares it against the `set_model_tag(...)` strings found in the tree. It already needed an edit when Medusa was removed upstream, and now every tag change touches this file. Could the expected set come from the module that defines the tags, or the test only assert that whatever it finds is classified?
- the pass is registered under `is_enabled() or is_rdna_aiter_enabled()`, but `use_asm_gemm` needs gfx950, so it can never match on gfx12. Moving just this pass into the `is_enabled()` branch would also answer tpopp's question on #59153.

nit:
- the act test could pin the tuned lookup the way `tests/kernels/quantization/test_rocm_mxfp4.py:703` does, so a tuned config for its shape cannot quietly move it onto the fallback.
- the 24 act cases error instead of skipping on a machine without a GPU (`_ON_GFX950` stays true with no device, then `torch.set_default_device("cuda")`). Only matters outside CI, but a device skip like `tests/kernels/quantization/test_triton_w4a16.py:158` would cover it.

Perhaps @tjtanaa can comment on these?

- the flag name. Should this one be `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ACT_QUANT_FUSION`?
- does it need to fail the start? In tree, fusions that cannot apply warn and skip (e.g. allreduce_rms), and main has no finish-compile hook at all, so failing is new surface: `backends.py` +8, a mixin, and about 300 lines of manager/backend tests. If a warning is enough, all of that goes away and what is left is the flag, one log line and the docs.

Purpose of this PR: #59153 registers its fusion whenever `fuse_act_quant` is on, so every MXFP4 start on ROCm with that switch rewrites the down_proj sites, and its M <= 64 path was about 1.6% slower than flag off at 32 users. This PR puts the fusion behind an opt-in flag, removes the small-batch cost, and logs how many sites were fused.

Timeline, for transparency on how this PR changed with updates on vLLM main as of 11/1/2026:
- 10-15: this PR was opened for Qwen3.8-27B on an MI350P, where the fusion rewrote 64 sites (older image, locally tuned AITER tables).
- 10-17: #61278 merged. Since then the asm GEMM is chosen only for shapes that also have a tuned Triton preshuffle config, and AITER has none for the 27B's shapes, so the 27B fuses 0 sites on current main.
- this round: the measurements below therefore use Llama-3.3-70B, whose shapes have configs.

Changes from this round:
- Flag renamed to `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ACT_QUANT_FUSION`.
- The pass is registered only under `rocm_aiter_ops.is_enabled()`, since it needs the gfx950 asm GEMM.
- The start-up check, its hooks and their tests are removed. The pass warns and skips like the other fusion passes, with one debug line per pass call (`Fused act+mxfp4 quant at N sites`); the count is also in the fusion match table.
- Small batches: the remaining act-and-mul path uses the fused `_C` op, and with the flag on the compile ranges split at 64 tokens, so batches of 64 tokens or fewer run the flag-off graph.
- CI: both test files are added to the MI355 "Fusion and Compile FP8" job in `test-amd.yaml` and `test_areas/compile.yaml`.
- The act test pins the tuned-config lookup and skips without a GPU; a 72-token case covers a partial last tile.
- The AITER import uses `aiter.ops.triton.fusions.activation` (the old path still resolves through AITER's alias).
- With the flag on, start-up logs ROCm's warning that native tanh GELU is unstable, because the pass builds the tanh matcher. SiLU models are not affected.

Measurements: Llama-3.3-70B MXFP4, MI350P, nightly 335dd77b with this PR's files. `CU_NUM=256` is set so AITER uses its shipped 256-CU (MI355X) tuned tables: the MI350P has 128 CUs and AITER does not ship 128-CU asm rows yet (ROCm/aiter#6638, #7075). On an MI355X no override is needed. Six alternating starts per arm over two cards; change is the mean of the paired ON vs OFF deltas, with a 95% bootstrap interval.

| workload | change with the flag on | 95% interval |
|---|---|---|
| decode, 32 users (TPOT) | no measurable change | -0.1% to +0.4% |
| decode, 96 users (output tok/s) | +0.8% | +0.4% to +1.3% |
| decode, 128 users (output tok/s) | +0.8% | +0.5% to +1.2% |
| prefill, 4,096 tokens (TTFT) | -1.7% | -1.9% to -1.5% |


The speedup comes from the #59153 fusion. Qwen3.8-27B shows no change on main (0 sites).

If a smaller change is preferred, the opt-in flag and the small-batch fix can move into #59153 instead, and this PR can be closed.

@vllmellm Thanks for the review. All points are addressed; details and measurements are above. On small M: the M <= 64 path was slower than flag off (about 1.6% at 32 users); with the fused `_C` op and the compile-range split at 64 it now shows no measurable change.

#59610 changes the same files on the Triton path. Is there a preferred order for rebasing between the two?

@tjtanaa on the two questions above (flag name, fail vs warn): the flag is now VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ACT_QUANT_FUSION and the pass warns and skips, as proposed. Either can be revisited if you prefer otherwise

+class AiterActMulMxfp4GemmPattern(VllmPatternReplacement):
+    """Folds act_and_mul into the AITER MXFP4 GEMM that consumes it.
+
+    The ASM MXFP4 linear quantizes its input inside gemm_with_dynamic_quant, a
+    custom op Inductor cannot fuse into. This pattern hands the op the
+    concatenated gate/up tensor plus the activation name instead, and the op
+    runs aiter's act_mul_and_mxfp4_quant: one kernel instead of an activation
+    kernel plus a quant kernel.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        act_matcher: MatcherGeluAndMul | MatcherSiluAndMul,
+        activation: str,
+        out_dtype: torch.dtype,
+    ) -> None:
+        # gemm_with_dynamic_quant is registered when the MXFP4 kernel module
+        # is imported, so resolve it here rather than at class definition.
+        importlib.import_module("vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.mxfp4.aiter")
+
+        self.gemm_op = torch.ops.vllm.gemm_with_dynamic_quant.default
+        self.act_matcher = act_matcher
+        self.activation = activation
+        self.out_dtype = out_dtype
+
+    def get_inputs(self) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+        x = self.act_matcher.inputs()[0]
+        weight = self.empty(8, 1, dtype=torch.uint8)
+        weight_scale = self.empty(8, 1, dtype=torch.uint8)
+        return [x, weight, weight_scale]
+
+    @property
+    def pattern(self):
+        def _pattern(
+            x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor, weight_scale: torch.Tensor
+        ) -> torch.Tensor:
+            y = self.act_matcher(x)
+            return self.gemm_op(y, weight, weight_scale, True, self.out_dtype)
+
+        return _pattern

detail.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->


**Update**: this PR now covers the act+MXFP4 quant fusion only (See below comment)
**Update (review round 2):** rebased on current main; changes and new measurements are in [this comment](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61902#issuecomment-6562210527). The run A4 table and the GSM8K block under Measurements are the newest figures in this body. The Qwen3.8-27B act-site count (64) an earlier version of this body reported predates #61278, it is 0 on current main, and it is not repeated here.


## Overview

Put the AITER act_and_mul + MXFP4 activation-quant fusion of #59153 behind an opt-in env flag (`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ACT_QUANT_FUSION`, gfx950 only), fix the small-batch path, split the compile ranges where the fusion stops paying, and add CI and tests. Builds on #59153 (its commit is the first commit of this PR, unchanged). Today that pass is registered whenever `fuse_act_quant` is on (by default vLLM enables that switch only in some configurations), so every start of an MXFP4 model on ROCm with that switch on would rewrite its down_proj sites. With this PR a default start is unchanged. With the flag on, the pass logs one line per pass call saying how many patterns it replaced, and the flag cannot fail a start: a model with no site logs 0 and runs.

The two Gemma add+RMSNorm fusions this PR first carried (the post-attention norm and the input norm) were dropped from this PR. On main the asm MXFP4 GEMM is chosen only for shapes that also have a tuned Triton preshuffle config (`process_weights_after_loading`, since #61278), and the fused norm op cannot serve those shapes yet (the small-M Triton branch reads unshuffled scales, the op writes the asm layout), so those fusions could not fire on main.

Not a duplicate: this PR adds no new fusion, the speed comes from #59153's kernel. #59153 is the fusion (SiLU/GELU+Mul before the down projection, on the asm path); this PR gates it, fixes the small-batch path it left, splits the compile ranges, and adds CI and tests. #59610 folds RMSNorm and SiLU+Mul into the MXFP4 quant on the Triton `afp4wfp4` path, which this pass does not touch. The files overlap with #59610 (`mxfp4/aiter.py`, `rocm_aiter_fusion.py`); both PRs conflict with #59153 in `mxfp4/aiter.py` in the same place, and I will rebase on whichever lands first.

## Claims

- On gfx950 with `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ACT_QUANT_FUSION=1` (and `fuse_act_quant` on, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`), each SiLU/GELU+Mul that feeds an asm MXFP4 GEMM (a down_proj) in a compile range above 64 tokens becomes one AITER kernel, as in #59153.
- Observable with the flag on: the pass logs one INFO line per pass call, `AITER act-mul + MXFP4 GEMM fusion: replaced N pattern(s)`, and the same count goes to the debug summary `fusion pass matches`. It is warn-and-skip, not a failure: when the model has no site, when AITER picks the Triton preshuffle GEMM for every shape, or when Inductor served every piece from its cache so the pass never ran, nothing is replaced and the start continues. An earlier version of this PR failed the start in some of those cases; that check is gone.
- Nothing changes with the flag unset (default off; the pass also needs `fuse_act_quant` on, AITER enabled and a gfx950). With the flag off there is no extra compile-range split either.
- With the flag on, compile ranges split at 64 tokens and the pass applies only to ranges that start above 64 (`MXFP4_PRESHUFFLE_MAX_M`), so a batch of 64 tokens or fewer compiles the unfused graph and the start compiles one more range. There the activation runs on the fused `_C` act-and-mul ops. Run A4's 32 user decode shows no measurable change.
- Speed and accuracy with only this flag on: measured on Llama 3.3 70B MXFP4 in run A4 and the GSM8K block under Measurements. Prefill TTFT median -1.8%, decode at 96 and 128 users around 1% better (mixed evidence, see the note under the table), decode at 32 users unchanged, GSM8K 5-shot exact match (flexible extract) 93.00% off and 94.33% on. An earlier version of this body claimed an act-site count of 64 on Qwen3.8-27B from a start-up log on an older head; that log no longer exists, the count was never taken on this head, and it is dropped here.

## Validation

Tests (the gating file, 38 cases, is new in this PR; `test_rocm_aiter_act_mul_mxfp4_fusion.py`, 45 cases, is #59153's own test file carried as this PR's first commit, plus 4 cases this PR adds: 3 for the tanh gate and 1 for the INFO log line of the pass):

```bash
pytest tests/compile/passes/test_rocm_aiter_mxfp4_fusion_gating.py \
       tests/compile/passes/test_rocm_aiter_act_mul_mxfp4_fusion.py -v
```

Both files run in the `:amd: (MI355) Fusion and Compile FP8` ROCm job in `.buildkite/test-amd.yaml`, which is marked optional there. Both files are also listed in `.buildkite/test_areas/compile.yaml`.

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| CPU emulation (fake ROCm and AITER), both files | 41 passed, 42 skipped (GPU-only cases skip on CPU) |
| MI350P, both files, image A | Gating: 37 passed, 1 skipped. Act: 27 passed, 18 failed (see note) |
| MI350P, act file, image B | 45 passed, including the 4 new tests |
| `ruff check`, `ruff format --check` (0.14.0) | clean |
| pre-commit hooks on the changed files | all passed |

Image A: `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm@sha256:e0be00f1b99da608cc3c8571c7c86bae0c05f19e1e61a59c1d70aeea6bca6140`

Image B: `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm@sha256:d92e7eb1171463b6a653eb0573e64ffdab15b668a26b3bef24b469914c707174`

Note: the 18 failures on image A are the asm-path cases. Each fails at import with `No module named 'aiter.ops.triton.fusions.activation'` because that AITER module is missing from the image. The code before this PR fails the same 18 there. Image B has the module and passes all 45.

The measured checkpoint is `amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4` with its `config.json` edited: eight module names of the MTP head were added to the end of the `quantization_config.exclude` list, so those modules are excluded from quantization. The names are `mtp.fc`, `mtp.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj`, `mtp.layers.0.self_attn.k_proj`, `mtp.layers.0.self_attn.v_proj`, `mtp.layers.0.self_attn.o_proj`, `mtp.layers.0.mlp.gate_proj`, `mtp.layers.0.mlp.up_proj` and `mtp.layers.0.mlp.down_proj`. The stock `config.json` was not measured. `<checkpoint dir>` below is a local directory with that edited copy.

Reproduce the fusion (one gfx950 card). With the flag on, the pass logs `AITER act-mul + MXFP4 GEMM fusion: replaced N pattern(s)` at INFO level, once per pass call. This exact command was not run on this head. The variable `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ASM_GEMM`, which an earlier version of this command set, is removed on main by #61278, so it is not set here. The `fuse_act_quant` pass switch must also be on (by default vLLM enables it only in some configurations), so the command sets it explicitly:

```bash
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ACT_QUANT_FUSION=1
vllm serve <checkpoint dir> --served-model-name amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 --max-model-len 60000 --max-num-seqs 128 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 --kv-cache-dtype auto --enable-prefix-caching \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA --gdn-prefill-backend aiter_flydsl \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3 --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":3,"video":0}' \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":2}' \
  -cc.pass_config.fuse_act_quant=True
```

**Measurements.** The end-to-end figures for this flag alone are the run A4 table and the GSM8K block below, both on Llama 3.3 70B MXFP4. The only figure an earlier version of this section carried was a Qwen3.8-27B act-site count taken from a start-up log that this PR removes; it is dropped.

Run A4 (Llama 3.3 70B MXFP4, two MI350P cards running at the same time, three OFF/ON pairs per card, six starts per arm with the flag off and the flag on, the server flags of run A3). `CU_NUM=256` was set, so AITER's 256-CU tuned tables apply on these 128-CU cards. The paired mean is the mean of the six ON-minus-OFF differences; the interval (95%) is a bootstrap over those six differences; the p value is an exact two-sided permutation test over the six OFF and six ON starts.

| metric | OFF median | ON median | median change | paired mean (95% CI) | p |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| prefill, 4096-token prompt: TTFT (ms) | 516.57 | 507.43 | -1.8% | -1.7% (-1.9 to -1.5) | 0.002 |
| decode, 32 users: TPOT (ms) | 32.32 | 32.39 | +0.2% | +0.1% (-0.1 to +0.4) | 0.82 |
| decode, 96 users: TPOT (ms) | 60.02 | 59.40 | -1.0% | -0.8% (-1.3 to -0.2) | 0.13 |
| decode, 96 users: output tok/s | 1463.10 | 1480.17 | +1.2% | +0.8% (+0.4 to +1.3) | 0.09 |
| decode, 128 users: TPOT (ms) | 75.38 | 74.60 | -1.0% | -0.7% (-1.1 to -0.2) | 0.49 |
| decode, 128 users: output tok/s | 1581.47 | 1602.44 | +1.3% | +0.8% (+0.5 to +1.2) | 0.18 |

The table shows a small prefill gain and small decode gains at 96 and 128 users, and no measurable change in 32 user decode. For the 96 and 128 user decode rows the paired 95% interval excludes 0, but the unpaired test gives p above 0.05, so treat those gains as likely but small.

GSM8K (Llama 3.3 70B MXFP4, run A3, flags as run A4):

- lm_eval `gsm8k`, 5-shot, 300 questions (lm_eval limit 300).
- Exact match, flexible-extract: flag off 93.00%, flag on 94.33%.
- Exact match, strict-match: flag off 1.00%, flag on 2.33%. Strict match needs the exact answer format, so it is low for both arms.
- The two arms differ by 4 of the 300 questions.

## Details

**The gate.** `act_mxfp4_pass_registered` (`vllm/_aiter_ops.py`) is the single rule for the pass: `rocm_aiter_ops.is_enabled()`, the pass config's `fuse_act_quant`, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ACT_QUANT_FUSION=1` and a gfx950. `PostGradPassManager` registers `RocmAiterActMulMxfp4GemmFusionPass` only when that holds. The other AITER passes have a rule for RDNA AITER (gfx12); this one does not register there, because the asm MXFP4 GEMM it folds into needs gfx950. The flag is part of the compile cache key like every vLLM env var (a test checks that the flag changes the compile cache key).

**The compile-range split.** `VllmConfig` adds a compile-range endpoint at `MXFP4_PRESHUFFLE_MAX_M` (64, `vllm/_aiter_ops.py`) exactly when that same rule holds, and the pass's `is_applicable_for_range` applies it only to ranges that start above 64. At 64 tokens or fewer AITER can pick its tuned Triton preshuffle GEMM, where `gemm_with_dynamic_quant` splits the activation out again, so the fusion would save nothing there. With the flag on the split applies to any model, so a start compiles one more range.

**Small batches.** In the branch the fusion does not cover, `gemm_with_dynamic_quant` calls `_act_and_mul`, which runs one `torch.ops._C.silu_and_mul`, `gelu_and_mul` or `gelu_tanh_and_mul` per call instead of an eager activation and multiply, so the small-batch path no longer runs a separate eager activation kernel.

**The ROCm tanh GELU warning.** The pass now builds the tanh GELU pattern only when the `gelu_and_mul` custom op is on. With it off (the default under torch.compile), that pattern traces to the same graph as exact GELU on ROCm and was dropped anyway, so the pass no longer creates the layer and the warning is not logged. With it on, the warning still logs once per process.

**Limits.** gfx950 asm MXFP4 path only. The fusion applies to the down_proj layers where AITER selects the asm GEMM, which on main means shapes with both an asm tuned config and a tuned Triton preshuffle config; layers with other shapes are left unfused and the pass simply reports 0 replacements there. Size: 13 files changed (10 under `vllm/` and `tests/`, plus two CI files and one doc), 1139 lines added and 6 removed, about 870 of them tests. Expected to work on any gfx950 (MI350X, MI355X, MI350P); tested only on MI350P (128 CU). On 256-CU parts, AITER's shipped tuned tables route some GEMM shapes to the Triton preshuffle path, which is not an asm GEMM and so not a site, so fewer sites may fuse there.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+import logging
+from collections.abc import Iterator
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from tests.compile.backend import TestBackend
+from vllm._aiter_ops import IS_AITER_FOUND, rocm_aiter_ops
+from vllm.compilation.passes.utility.noop_elimination import NoOpEliminationPass
+from vllm.compilation.passes.utility.post_cleanup import PostCleanupPass
+from vllm.config import (
+    CompilationConfig,
+    CompilationMode,
+    PassConfig,
+    VllmConfig,
+    set_current_vllm_config,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.activation import GeluAndMul, SiluAndMul
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.compilation.passes.fusion.rocm_aiter_fusion import (
+        RocmAiterActMulMxfp4GemmFusionPass,
+    )
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (current_platform.is_rocm() and IS_AITER_FOUND),
+    reason="ROCm with AITER only",
+)
+
+DTYPE = torch.bfloat16
+HIDDEN_SIZE = 1024
+
+
+def _is_gfx950() -> bool:
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    return on_gfx950()
+
+
+def _skip_unless_gfx950() -> None:
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        pytest.skip("CUDA/HIP device not available")
+    if not _is_gfx950():
+        pytest.skip("AITER MXFP4 GEMM needs gfx950")
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def _fusion_pass_under_test(
+    custom_ops: list[str],
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+    presh_ws_tuned: bool = False,
+) -> Iterator[tuple["RocmAiterActMulMxfp4GemmFusionPass", TestBackend]]:
+    """Yield the act fusion pass and a TestBackend that runs it.
+
+    Compiles with the given custom ops, bfloat16 on the default CUDA/HIP device, and
+    a fixed seed. AITER is on and the tuned preshuffled lookup is pinned to
+    ``presh_ws_tuned`` (off by default) until the block exits.
+    """
+    torch.set_default_device("cuda")
+    torch.set_default_dtype(DTYPE)
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    config = VllmConfig(
+        compilation_config=CompilationConfig(
+            mode=CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE,
+            custom_ops=custom_ops,
+            backend="eager",
+            pass_config=PassConfig(fuse_act_quant=True, eliminate_noops=True),
+        ),
+    )
+
+    with set_current_vllm_config(config), monkeypatch.context() as m:
+        m.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER", "1")
+        rocm_aiter_ops.refresh_env_variables()
+        # Off keeps the fused path under test at every M. On sends M <= 64 down the
+        # small-M branch, which runs the activation as a separate kernel call.
+        m.setattr(
+            rocm_aiter_ops,
+            "is_triton_gemm_afp4wfp4_presh_ws_tuned",
+            lambda n, k: presh_ws_tuned,
+        )
+        from vllm.compilation.passes.fusion.rocm_aiter_fusion import (
+            RocmAiterActMulMxfp4GemmFusionPass,
+        )
+
+        fusion_pass = RocmAiterActMulMxfp4GemmFusionPass(config)
+        backend = TestBackend(
+            NoOpEliminationPass(config), fusion_pass, PostCleanupPass(config)
+        )
+        yield fusion_pass, backend
+
+
+class ActMulMxfp4Model(torch.nn.Module):
+    """act_and_mul feeding an MXFP4 weight through the AITER ASM GEMM op."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        act: torch.nn.Module,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        dtype: torch.dtype,
+        use_asm_gemm: bool,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        import aiter
+        from aiter.ops.shuffle import shuffle_weight
+
+        self.act = act
+        self.dtype = dtype
+        self.use_asm_gemm = use_asm_gemm
+        w = torch.randn(hidden_size, hidden_size, dtype=dtype) * 0.02
+        self.w_ref = w
+        w_q, w_s = aiter.per_1x32_f4_quant_hip(w, shuffle=False)
+        w_q, w_s = w_q.view(torch.uint8), w_s.view(torch.uint8)
+        # The layouts AiterMxfp4LinearKernel.process_weights_after_loading
+        # produces for each GEMM path.
+        if use_asm_gemm:
+            sm, sn = w_s.shape
+            w_s = (
+                w_s.view(sm // 32, 2, 16, sn // 8, 2, 4, 1)
+                .permute(0, 3, 5, 2, 4, 1, 6)
+                .contiguous()
+                .view(sm, sn)
+            )
+            w_q = shuffle_weight(w_q, layout=(16, 16))
+        else:
+            w_s = w_s.T.contiguous()
+        self.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(w_q, requires_grad=False)
+        self.weight_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(w_s, requires_grad=False)
+
+    def exact(self, x: torch.Tensor, act_name: str) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """act(gate) * up in fp32 against the unquantized weight."""
+        d = x.shape[-1] // 2
+        gate, up = x[..., :d].float(), x[..., d:].float()
+        if act_name == "silu":
+            h = torch.nn.functional.silu(gate) * up
+        else:
+            approximate = "tanh" if act_name == "gelu_tanh" else "none"
+            h = torch.nn.functional.gelu(gate, approximate=approximate) * up
+        return h @ self.w_ref.float().T
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        y = self.act(x)
+        return torch.ops.vllm.gemm_with_dynamic_quant(
+            y, self.weight, self.weight_scale, self.use_asm_gemm, self.dtype
+        )
+
+
+# Input: num_tokens rows. Expected: one fused GEMM, and a fused error against
+# the exact product within 1.05x of the eager path's. 72 is a decode capture
+# size above 64 whose last 32-row tile is partial (24 rows masked): the only
+# parametrized M with several tiles and a partial one.
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_asm_gemm", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_tokens", [16, 72, 256])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("act_name", ["silu", "gelu", "gelu_tanh"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("enable_act_custom_op", [True, False])
+def test_rocm_aiter_act_mul_mxfp4_gemm_fusion(
+    use_asm_gemm: bool,
+    num_tokens: int,
+    act_name: str,
+    enable_act_custom_op: bool,
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+):
+    _skip_unless_gfx950()
+    custom_op = "gelu_and_mul" if act_name.startswith("gelu") else "silu_and_mul"
+    custom_ops = ["none"] + ([f"+{custom_op}"] if enable_act_custom_op else [])
+    with _fusion_pass_under_test(custom_ops, monkeypatch) as (fusion_pass, backend):
+        if act_name == "silu":
+            act = SiluAndMul()
+        else:
+            act = GeluAndMul("tanh" if act_name == "gelu_tanh" else "none")
+        model = ActMulMxfp4Model(act, HIDDEN_SIZE, DTYPE, use_asm_gemm)
+
+        x = torch.randn(num_tokens, 2 * HIDDEN_SIZE)
+        torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic(x, 0)
+        ref = model(x)
+        out = torch.compile(model, backend=backend)(x)
+
+        if not use_asm_gemm:
+            # The Triton GEMM path keeps Inductor's act_and_mul: measured on
+            # MI355X, aiter's fused act + quant was slower there.
+            assert fusion_pass.matched_count == 0
+            return
+        assert fusion_pass.matched_count == 1
+        gemm_nodes = [
+            n
+            for n in backend.graph_post_pass.nodes
+            if n.target == torch.ops.vllm.gemm_with_dynamic_quant.default
+        ]
+        assert len(gemm_nodes) == 1
+        # The fused op must compute what the matched graph computed: on ROCm the
+        # native GeluAndMul drops the tanh approximation (see forward_native).
+        if act_name == "silu":
+            expected = "silu"
+        elif act_name == "gelu_tanh" and (
+            enable_act_custom_op or not current_platform.is_rocm()
+        ):
+            expected = "gelu_tanh"
+        else:
+            expected = "gelu"
+        assert gemm_nodes[0].args[-1] == expected
+
+        # The fused path quantizes act(gate) * up with aiter's Triton kernel
+        # instead of the HIP quant, so individual MXFP4 roundings differ. Hold it
+        # to the unfused path's accuracy against the exact product.
+        exact = model.exact(x, act_name)
+
+        def rel(y: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+            return ((y.float() - exact).norm() / exact.norm()).item()
+
+        assert rel(out) <= rel(ref) * 1.05 + 1e-3, (rel(out), rel(ref))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("act_name", ["silu", "gelu", "gelu_tanh"])
+def test_rocm_aiter_act_mul_mxfp4_small_m_tuned_path_matches_eager(
+    act_name: str, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+):
+    # Input: 16 rows of gate and up with the tuned preshuffled lookup pinned on, so the
+    # fused op takes the M <= 64 branch that runs _act_and_mul as a separate
+    # kernel call.
+    # Expected: the pass still matches the one act-and-GEMM pair, and the compiled
+    # output equals the eager model's output within bfloat16 tolerance.
+    # Why: this branch had no test, so a change to _act_and_mul could break the
+    # small-M path without any test noticing.
+    _skip_unless_gfx950()
+    custom_op = "gelu_and_mul" if act_name.startswith("gelu") else "silu_and_mul"
+    with _fusion_pass_under_test(
+        [f"+{custom_op}"], monkeypatch, presh_ws_tuned=True
+    ) as (fusion_pass, backend):
+        if act_name == "silu":
+            act = SiluAndMul()
+        else:
+            act = GeluAndMul("tanh" if act_name == "gelu_tanh" else "none")
+        model = ActMulMxfp4Model(act, HIDDEN_SIZE, DTYPE, use_asm_gemm=True)
+
+        x = torch.randn(16, 2 * HIDDEN_SIZE)
+        torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic(x, 0)
+        ref = model(x)
+        out = torch.compile(model, backend=backend)(x)
+
+        assert fusion_pass.matched_count == 1
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out, ref)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_tokens", [16, 256])
+def test_asm_mxfp4_gemm_on_a_plain_input_is_not_rewritten(
+    num_tokens: int, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+):
+    # Input: an asm MXFP4 GEMM fed by a plain tensor, as qkv_proj is, with no SiLU or
+    # GELU-and-mul in front. Expected: the pass matches nothing, the graph still calls
+    # gemm_with_dynamic_quant with no activation, and the output equals the eager one.
+    # Why: a loosened pattern would apply an activation to a qkv_proj input and give
+    # wrong output silently.
+    _skip_unless_gfx950()
+    with _fusion_pass_under_test(["none"], monkeypatch) as (fusion_pass, backend):
+        # Identity in front: the GEMM's input is the plain tensor itself.
+        model = ActMulMxfp4Model(
+            torch.nn.Identity(), HIDDEN_SIZE, DTYPE, use_asm_gemm=True
+        )
+
+        x = torch.randn(num_tokens, HIDDEN_SIZE)
+        torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic(x, 0)
+        ref = model(x)
+        out = torch.compile(model, backend=backend)(x)
+
+        assert fusion_pass.matched_count == 0
+        gemm_nodes = [
+            n
+            for n in backend.graph_post_pass.nodes
+            if n.target == torch.ops.vllm.gemm_with_dynamic_quant.default
+        ]
+        assert len(gemm_nodes) == 1
+        # The activation is the op's seventh argument or keyword. The plain call
+        # passes neither, so the activation is None.
+        gemm_node = gemm_nodes[0]
+        activation = gemm_node.args[6] if len(gemm_node.args) > 6 else None
+        assert activation is None and "activation" not in gemm_node.kwargs
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out, ref)
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def _act_mul_pass_built_with(
+    custom_ops: list[str],
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+) -> Iterator["RocmAiterActMulMxfp4GemmFusionPass"]:
+    """Yield the act fusion pass built with the given custom ops.
+
+    Unlike _fusion_pass_under_test this leaves the torch default device and dtype
+    alone and builds no TestBackend, so the pass can be inspected without a GPU
+    device.
+    """
+    config = VllmConfig(
+        compilation_config=CompilationConfig(
+            mode=CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE,
+            custom_ops=custom_ops,
+            backend="eager",
+            pass_config=PassConfig(fuse_act_quant=True, eliminate_noops=True),
+        ),
+    )
+
+    with set_current_vllm_config(config), monkeypatch.context() as m:
+        m.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER", "1")
+        rocm_aiter_ops.refresh_env_variables()
+        from vllm.compilation.passes.fusion.rocm_aiter_fusion import (
+            RocmAiterActMulMxfp4GemmFusionPass,
+        )
+
+        yield RocmAiterActMulMxfp4GemmFusionPass(config)
+
+
+def _record_gelu_builds(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> list[str]:
+    """Return a list collecting the approximate mode of every GeluAndMul built.
+
+    Install the spy before the pass is built: the pass constructs its matchers, and
+    with them the activation layers, in its own __init__.
+    """
+    built: list[str] = []
+    original_init = GeluAndMul.__init__
+
+    def recording_init(self: GeluAndMul, approximate: str = "none") -> None:
+        built.append(approximate)
+        original_init(self, approximate)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GeluAndMul, "__init__", recording_init)
+    return built
+
+
+def _registered_activations(
+    fusion_pass: "RocmAiterActMulMxfp4GemmFusionPass",
+) -> list[str]:
+    """The activation names the pass registered patterns for, sorted.
+
+    The pass keeps every pattern replacement it registered in _pattern_replacements,
+    and the isinstance check gives the type checker the activation attribute.
+    """
+    from vllm.compilation.passes.fusion.rocm_aiter_fusion import (
+        AiterActMulMxfp4GemmPattern,
+    )
+
+    return sorted(
+        pr.activation
+        for pr in fusion_pass._pattern_replacements
+        if isinstance(pr, AiterActMulMxfp4GemmPattern)
+    )
+
+
+# Input: custom_ops = ["none"], so the gelu_and_mul custom op is off and only the
+# native GELU graph can ever be matched. Expected: no GeluAndMul is built with the
+# tanh approximation. Why: the pass built MatcherGeluAndMul("tanh") anyway, which
+# constructs GeluAndMul("tanh") and logs ROCm's tanh warning, even though the matcher
+# is later dropped when its key collapses onto "gelu".
+def test_act_mul_pass_builds_no_tanh_gelu_when_gelu_custom_op_is_off(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+):
+    built = _record_gelu_builds(monkeypatch)
+    with _act_mul_pass_built_with(["none"], monkeypatch):
+        assert "tanh" not in built
+
+
+# Input: custom_ops = ["none"], so both GELU matchers trace to the same native graph.
+# Expected: the pass registers exactly the "gelu" and "silu" patterns. Why: guard for
+# the fix, dropping the tanh build must not drop the exact GELU fusion, the only GELU
+# one ROCm can match.
+def test_act_mul_pass_registers_only_silu_and_gelu_when_gelu_custom_op_is_off(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+):
+    with _act_mul_pass_built_with(["none"], monkeypatch) as fusion_pass:
+        assert _registered_activations(fusion_pass) == ["gelu", "silu"]
+
+
+# Input: custom_ops = ["none", "+gelu_and_mul"], so the custom-op form of GELU is
+# matched and tanh is a graph of its own. Expected: a GeluAndMul with the tanh
+# approximation is built and the pass registers "gelu", "gelu_tanh" and "silu".
+# Why: guard for the fix, the tanh build is only wrong while the custom op is off.
+def test_act_mul_pass_registers_gelu_tanh_when_gelu_custom_op_is_on(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+):
+    built = _record_gelu_builds(monkeypatch)
+    with _act_mul_pass_built_with(
+        ["none", "+gelu_and_mul"], monkeypatch
+    ) as fusion_pass:
+        assert "tanh" in built
+        assert _registered_activations(fusion_pass) == ["gelu", "gelu_tanh", "silu"]
+
+
+# Input: the pass built with custom_ops ["none"], and the base __call__ reporting 3
+# rewritten sites.
+# Expected: exactly one INFO record from the pass logger, with the text "AITER act-mul
+# + MXFP4 GEMM fusion: replaced 3 pattern(s)".
+# Why: the count is the pass's only log line. A level change back to debug would hide
+# it on every start, and this test must fail then.
+def test_act_mul_pass_call_logs_rewritten_count_at_info(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, caplog_vllm: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
+):
+    from vllm.compilation.passes.vllm_inductor_pass import (
+        VllmFusionPatternMatcherPass,
+    )
+
+    def count_three_sites(
+        self: VllmFusionPatternMatcherPass, graph: torch.fx.Graph
+    ) -> None:
+        self.matched_count = 3
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(VllmFusionPatternMatcherPass, "__call__", count_three_sites)
+
+    pass_logger = "vllm.compilation.passes.fusion.rocm_aiter_fusion"

+        ) -> torch.Tensor:
+            y = self.act_matcher(x)
+            return self.gemm_op(y, weight, weight_scale, True, self.out_dtype)
+
+        return _pattern
+
+    @property
+    def replacement(self):
+        def _replacement(
+            x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor, weight_scale: torch.Tensor
+        ) -> torch.Tensor:
+            return self.gemm_op(
+                x, weight, weight_scale, True, self.out_dtype, None, self.activation
+            )
+
+        return _replacement
+
+
+class RocmAiterActMulMxfp4GemmFusionPass(VllmFusionPatternMatcherPass):
+    """Fuses SiLU/GELU-and-mul into the following AITER ASM MXFP4 GEMM."""
+
+    def __init__(self, config: VllmConfig) -> None:
+        super().__init__(config, "rocm_aiter_act_mul_mxfp4_gemm_fusion_pass")
+        out_dtype: torch.dtype = self.model_dtype or torch.bfloat16
+        matchers: dict[tuple[bool, str], MatcherGeluAndMul | MatcherSiluAndMul] = {}
+        silu = MatcherSiluAndMul()
+        matchers[(silu.enabled, "silu")] = silu
+        for approximate in ("none", "tanh"):
+            gelu = MatcherGeluAndMul(approximate)
+            # On ROCm both approximations trace to the same native graph.
+            matchers.setdefault((gelu.enabled, gelu.activation), gelu)
+        for (_, activation), matcher in matchers.items():
+            self.register(AiterActMulMxfp4GemmPattern(matcher, activation, out_dtype))
+
+        self.dump_patterns(config, self.pm_pass)
+
+    def is_applicable_for_range(self, compile_range: Range) -> bool:
+        # Ranges of MXFP4_PRESHUFFLE_MAX_M tokens or fewer compile the unfused graph:
+        # there the activation is split out again in the `activation` branch of
+        # gemm_with_dynamic_quant (vllm/model_executor/kernels/linear/mxfp4/aiter.py),
+        # so the fusion saves nothing (vllm/_aiter_ops.py). A single-size range follows
+        # the same rule.
+        return compile_range.start > MXFP4_PRESHUFFLE_MAX_M
+
+    def __call__(self, graph: torch.fx.Graph) -> None:
+        super().__call__(graph)
+        logger.debug("Fused act+mxfp4 quant at %d sites", self.matched_count)

I force-pushed a smaller version: 7 commits became 3 (old head 0c15c43, new head 5857a79), and I changed the title to match.

Hi @fyun89, thanks for the rescope. A few things:

In tree, fusions that cannot apply warn and skip (e.g. allreduce_rms), and main has no finish-compile hook at all, so failing is new surface: `backends.py` +8, a mixin, and about 300 lines of manager/backend tests. If a warning is enough, all of that goes away and what is left is the flag, one log line and the docs.

Purpose of this PR: #59153 registers its fusion whenever `fuse_act_quant` is on, so every MXFP4 start on ROCm with that switch rewrites the down_proj sites, and its M <= 64 path was about 1.6% slower than flag off at 32 users. This PR puts the fusion behind an opt-in flag, removes the small-batch cost, and logs how many sites were fused.

Timeline, for transparency on how this PR changed with updates on vLLM main as of 11/1/2026:
- 10-15: this PR was opened for Qwen3.8-27B on an MI350P, where the fusion rewrote 64 sites (older image, locally tuned AITER tables).
- 10-17: #61278 merged. Since then the asm GEMM is chosen only for shapes that also have a tuned Triton preshuffle config, and AITER has none for the 27B's shapes, so the 27B fuses 0 sites on current main.
- this round: the measurements below therefore use Llama-3.3-70B, whose shapes have configs.

Changes from this round:
- Flag renamed to `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ACT_QUANT_FUSION`.
- The pass is registered only under `rocm_aiter_ops.is_enabled()`, since it needs the gfx950 asm GEMM.
- The start-up check, its hooks and their tests are removed. The pass warns and skips like the other fusion passes, with one debug line per pass call (`Fused act+mxfp4 quant at N sites`); the count is also in the fusion match table.
- Small batches: the remaining act-and-mul path uses the fused `_C` op, and with the flag on the compile ranges split at 64 tokens, so batches of 64 tokens or fewer run the flag-off graph.
- CI: both test files are added to the MI355 "Fusion and Compile FP8" job in `test-amd.yaml` and `test_areas/compile.yaml`.
- The act test pins the tuned-config lookup and skips without a GPU; a 72-token case covers a partial last tile.
- The AITER import uses `aiter.ops.triton.fusions.activation` (the old path still resolves through AITER's alias).
- With the flag on, start-up logs ROCm's warning that native tanh GELU is unstable, because the pass builds the tanh matcher. SiLU models are not affected.

Measurements: Llama-3.3-70B MXFP4, MI350P, nightly 335dd77b with this PR's files. `CU_NUM=256` is set so AITER uses its shipped 256-CU (MI355X) tuned tables: the MI350P has 128 CUs and AITER does not ship 128-CU asm rows yet (ROCm/aiter#6638, #7075). On an MI355X no override is needed. Six alternating starts per arm over two cards; change is the mean of the paired ON vs OFF deltas, with a 95% bootstrap interval.

| decode, 32 users (TPOT) | no measurable change | -0.1% to +0.4% |
| decode, 96 users (output tok/s) | +0.8% | +0.4% to +1.3% |
| decode, 128 users (output tok/s) | +0.8% | +0.5% to +1.2% |
| prefill, 4,096 tokens (TTFT) | -1.7% | -1.9% to -1.5% |
